annotations.title: Usual rent in a Swiss canton (Mietcheck)

description: The usual net monthly rent by flat size in a Swiss canton, from the Federal Statistical Office (BFS), via Mietcheck (mietcheck.zzd.ch, free, by zzd). Give a canton or a place (postal code or municipality); with rooms and the net rent it also says whether that rent is below, within or above the usual range. A place in several cantons returns the candidates to choose from. Cantonal averages only: not street level, not legal advice. The result links the matching Mietcheck page.

canton.description: Canton code (ZH), slug or name. Use this or place.

lang.description: Language of the answer and links. Default de.

netRent.description: Monthly NET rent in CHF (without service charges and heating). Needs rooms.

place.description: Postal code or municipality, e.g. '8001' or 'Winterthur'.

rooms.description: Number of rooms; 6 means 6 or more.
